medicoLegal.title: Medico-legal traceability
medicoLegal.subtitle: Third parties, capacity to consent, emergency legal basis and personal belongings. This information is protected and audited.
medicoLegal.thirdParty.title: Accompanying persons, declarants and witnesses
medicoLegal.thirdParty.hint: Each person is recorded with their roles, source and confidence level. An accompanying person is never automatically treated as a legal representative.
medicoLegal.thirdParty.empty: No structured third party is associated with this emergency.
medicoLegal.thirdParty.form.title: Record a person present
medicoLegal.thirdParty.form.legalHint: Legal representation remains an unverified claim and does not automatically create any rights.
medicoLegal.thirdParty.contactConsentLab: The person agrees to be contacted again if needed.
medicoLegal.thirdParty.legalRepresentati: The person claims to be a presumed legal representative. This claim must be verified.
medicoLegal.thirdParty.statement.title: Information declared about the patient
medicoLegal.thirdParty.statement.hint: This information remains sourced and never overwrites a verified identity.
medicoLegal.capacity.title: Capacity to consent
medicoLegal.capacity.hint: Each assessment is retained in the history. Restored capacity automatically closes an active emergency legal basis.
medicoLegal.capacity.empty: No capacity assessment has been recorded.
medicoLegal.capacity.reasonPlaceholder: Describe the clinical findings supporting this assessment…
medicoLegal.capacity.appendOnlyHint: This assessment will be added to the history. Previous assessments are never overwritten.
medicoLegal.legalBasis.title: Emergency care legal basis
medicoLegal.legalBasis.hint: Document the justification, duration and acts strictly covered by the emergency exception.
medicoLegal.legalBasis.empty: No emergency legal basis has been recorded.
medicoLegal.legalBasis.justificationPlac: Explain why care cannot wait for consent…
medicoLegal.legalBasis.coveredActsPlaceh: E.g. airway management, IV access, urgent imaging
medicoLegal.legalBasis.coveredActsHint: Separate acts with commas, semicolons or line breaks.
medicoLegal.legalBasis.incapacityRequire: An active incapacity assessment is required for a vital emergency or presumed consent.
medicoLegal.legalBasis.closure.supersede: superseded by a new legal basis
medicoLegal.belonging.title: Personal belongings
medicoLegal.belonging.hint: Inventory, seals and a complete chain of custody through release or final disposal.
medicoLegal.belonging.empty: No personal belongings have been inventoried.
medicoLegal.belonging.recipientRequired: The recipient's name and identity document are required for release or return.
medicoLegal.patientHistory.title: Emergency medico-legal context
medicoLegal.patientHistory.protected: Protected information retained after stabilization and available only to authorized roles.
medicoLegal.patientHistory.restricted: A medico-legal context may exist, but your role is not authorized to view it.
